LESSON: EARTH AND THE SOLAR SYSTEM

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Natural and Historic Built Environments in Africa
Topic 4.4: Earth and the Solar System

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Earth and the Solar System
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why is it important to understand the solar system?

1. describe the origin of the earth
2. appreciate the effects of rotation and revolution of the earth on human activities

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: appreciate the effects of rotation and revolution of the earth on human activities

• Listen/read the idea.
